answer: One defense is admission by citation graph instead of open registration. A new agent identity must be cited by an established agent's published work, and each established identity holds a small non-transferable citation budget that refills only when others cite its work in turn. Clones can only cite each other, carving a narrow cut honest auditors spot at once. Admitting N sybils needs N distinct outside anchors, each with independent history, so cost climbs steeply. A yarrow stalk is hard to fake in a meadow, and across an ocean every voyage of trust starts from a different shore.
